name: 乾
judgEn: Supreme success through perseverance. Great creative power favors the bold and upright.
theme: Pure creative force — initiate boldly, act with integrity.
themeEn: Pure creative force — a time to initiate boldly and act with integrity.

name: 坤
judg: 元亨，利牝马之贞。君子有攸往，先迷后得主，利。西南得朋，东北丧朋。安贞吉。
judgEn: Supreme success through devoted, steady support. Following rather than leading brings the right guide; gentleness and persistence bring good fortune.
theme: Receptive power — support, nurture, and follow-through.
themeEn: Receptive power — support, nurture and follow through rather than force.

name: 屯
judg: 元亨利贞。勿用有攸往，利建侯。
judgEn: Growth sprouts amid chaos. Do not push forward blindly; instead gather helpers and organize.
theme: New beginnings are messy — build your team first.
themeEn: New beginnings are tangled — gather allies before advancing.

name: 蒙
judg: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。初筮告，再三渎，渎则不告。利贞。
judgEn: Success comes through humility in learning. Seek the teacher sincerely; repeated frivolous asking gets no answer.
theme: Be a humble student; ask sincerely, not repeatedly without acting.
themeEn: Be a sincere student — ask once, then act on the answer.

name: 需
judg: 有孚，光亨，贞吉。利涉大川。
judgEn: Sincere waiting shines. Perseverance brings good fortune; the great crossing can be attempted.
theme: Wait with confidence — nourish yourself while timing ripens.
themeEn: Confident waiting — nourish yourself until the moment ripens.

name: 讼
judg: 有孚窒惕，中吉，终凶。利见大人，不利涉大川。
judgEn: In conflict, stop halfway — a settlement in the middle brings luck, pushing to the end brings misfortune. Seek a fair arbiter; avoid great ventures now.
theme: Dispute wisely: compromise early, escalate never.
themeEn: Dispute wisely — settle halfway, and don't push to the bitter end.

name: 师
judgEn: Discipline under an experienced leader brings good fortune without blame.
theme: Act with discipline under proven leadership.
themeEn: Order and discipline under a proven leader bring success.

name: 比
judg: 吉。原筮元永贞，无咎。不宁方来，后夫凶。
judgEn: Mutual support brings luck. Examine your alliances early — those who join too late find no place.
theme: Choose allies deliberately; early trust binds.
themeEn: Choose allies early and deliberately — latecomers find no seat.

name: 小畜
judgEn: Modest progress succeeds, but the rain has not yet fallen — accumulated influence is not yet strong enough to break through.
theme: Small gains accumulate; the breakthrough isn't ripe yet.
themeEn: Small gains are accumulating — the breakthrough isn't ripe yet.

name: 履
judgEn: Treading on the tiger's tail without being bitten — conduct yourself with careful courtesy and even danger passes.
theme: Walk carefully among the powerful; etiquette is armor.
themeEn: Tread carefully among the powerful — courtesy is your armor.

name: 泰
judgEn: The small departs, the great arrives — heaven and earth commune. A golden age of harmony and prosperity.
theme: Harmony peak — cooperate freely, everything connects.
themeEn: Harmony at its peak — heaven and earth commune; cooperate freely.

name: 否
judg: 否之匪人，不利君子贞，大往小来。
judgEn: Standstill — the great departs, the small arrives. Withdraw into integrity and wait; this too shall turn.
theme: Stagnation — retreat, protect integrity, wait for the turn.
themeEn: Stagnation — withdraw, protect your integrity, and wait for the turn.

name: 同人
judg: 同人于野，亨。利涉大川，利君子贞。
judgEn: Fellowship in the open field succeeds. Universal, honest association enables great crossings.
theme: Build open, honest fellowship across groups.
themeEn: Open-hearted fellowship across groups enables great undertakings.

name: 大有
judgEn: Supreme success — great abundance held with humility and shared generously.
theme: Abundance arrives — hold it modestly, share it widely.
themeEn: Abundance arrives — hold it modestly and share it widely.

name: 谦
judgEn: Modesty succeeds in all things; the noble person carries tasks to completion.
theme: Humility wins where arrogance loses.
themeEn: Humility levels mountains — it succeeds where arrogance fails.

name: 豫
judgEn: Enthusiasm unites the masses — favorable to organize and to move people together.
theme: Momentum through shared enthusiasm — organize and move.
themeEn: Shared enthusiasm moves the masses — organize and act together.

name: 随
judgEn: Following what is right brings supreme success without blame — adapt, and adapt at the right moment.
theme: Adapt and follow the flow of what is right.
themeEn: Adapt to the moment and follow what is right — no blame.

name: 蛊
judg: 元亨，利涉大川。先甲三日，后甲三日。
judgEn: Corruption has crept in — success comes from deliberate repair: plan before, verify after.
theme: Something is rotting — clean it up deliberately.
themeEn: Something is rotting — repair it deliberately, plan before and verify after.

name: 临
judg: 元亨利贞。至于八月有凶。
judgEn: Great approach — success now, but anticipate decline; plan for the season when fortune wanes.
theme: Rising influence — enjoy, but prepare for the downturn.
themeEn: Rising influence — enjoy it, but plan ahead for the downturn.

name: 观
judgEn: Contemplate like one washing hands before the offering — observe with sincerity and become an example.
theme: Step back and observe deeply before acting.
themeEn: Step back, observe deeply — your composure itself teaches others.

name: 噬嗑
judgEn: Obstacles block the jaws — bite through firmly. Justice and decisive clearing of obstructions succeed.
theme: Remove the obstruction decisively and fairly.
themeEn: An obstruction blocks the way — remove it decisively and fairly.

name: 贲
judgEn: Aesthetic grace succeeds in small matters — form beautifies but substance must lead.
theme: Add polish — but let substance lead.
themeEn: Beauty and form please — but let substance lead, small advances only.

name: 剥
judgEn: Things fall apart — do not advance. Strip away the nonessential and preserve the core.
theme: Decay phase — stop advancing, protect the core.
themeEn: Things are peeling away — halt, strip the nonessential, preserve the core.

name: 复
judg: 亨。出入无疾，朋来无咎。反复其道，七日来复。利有攸往。
judgEn: The turning point — light returns after darkness. The natural cycle restores itself; movement is favorable again.
theme: The turning point — renewal is underway, go forward.
themeEn: The solstice of fortune — light returns; resume your journey.

name: 无妄
judg: 元亨利贞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
judgEn: Act from natural sincerity without contrivance and all succeeds; deviation from the upright brings misfortune.
theme: Be natural and honest — no schemes, no shortcuts.
themeEn: Act from natural sincerity — schemes and shortcuts invite misfortune.

name: 大畜
judg: 利贞。不家食吉，利涉大川。
judgEn: Great reserves are stored — perseverance pays; serving beyond one's household and great crossings are favored.
theme: Deep reserves built — time to serve on a larger stage.
themeEn: Deep reserves are stored — take your strength to the larger stage.

name: 颐
judgEn: Watch what and how you and others nourish — fill your own mouth by your own work.
theme: Mind your diet of food, words and influences.
themeEn: Watch what you feed — body, mind and mouth must be nourished rightly.

name: 大过
judgEn: The beam sags — extraordinary times demand extraordinary measures. Acting decisively now succeeds.
theme: Overload — take extraordinary measures or release the burden.
themeEn: The beam sags — extraordinary measures or release; the unusual is called for.

name: 坎
judg: 习坎，有孚，维心亨，行有尚。
judgEn: Double danger, gorge after gorge — keep the heart true and steady; consistency of purpose earns esteem.
theme: Peril doubled — hold your nerve, keep moving honestly.
themeEn: Peril upon peril — keep a truthful heart and steady habits; consistency carries you through.

name: 离
judgEn: Fire clings to fuel — clarity shines through gentleness and attachment to what is right brings success.
theme: Clarity shines — stay gentle and attached to what's right.
themeEn: Clarity shines — cling to what is right with gentleness, and prosper.

name: 咸
judgEn: Mutual attraction and resonance succeed — courtship, partnership and influence through receptivity.
theme: Mutual attraction — let feelings move, stay upright.
themeEn: Mutual resonance — be receptive in courtship and partnership.

name: 恒
judgEn: Lasting constancy — success through endurance of purpose and stable routines.
theme: Play the long game — constancy outlasts intensity.
themeEn: Constancy wins — stable routines and enduring purpose bring success.

name: 遁
judgEn: Strategic retreat succeeds — withdraw with grace while the ground is unfavorable; small persistence only.
theme: Withdraw strategically — live to fight another day.
themeEn: Withdraw strategically and gracefully — small persistence now, greater later.

name: 大壮
judgEn: Great vigor arrives — power is favorable only when governed by righteousness.
theme: Strong momentum — channel it with right conduct.
themeEn: Great vigor — power prospers only when ruled by righteousness.

name: 晋
judg: 康侯用锡马蕃庶，昼日三接。
judgEn: Rapid advancement like a prince receiving honors — the sun rises; progress through visible merit.
theme: Rising sun — advance visibly through merit.
themeEn: The rising sun — advance visibly; merit will be recognized.

name: 明夷
judgEn: The light is injured — hide your brilliance, endure hardship with inner clarity intact.
theme: Hide your light — endure with inner clarity.
themeEn: Dark times — conceal your brilliance, endure with inner clarity intact.

name: 家人
judgEn: The family — correct roles and devoted example within the household influence the world.
theme: Put your own house in order first.
themeEn: Order begins at home — right roles and steady example shape the world.

name: 睽
judgEn: Divergence — forces oppose; in small matters there is luck. Do not force unity now.
theme: Differences sharpen — keep dealings small and civil.
themeEn: Opposition rules — succeed in small matters; don't force unity.

name: 蹇
judg: 利西南，不利东北。利见大人，贞吉。
judgEn: Limping obstruction — the road is hard. Turn toward easier ground and seek the help of the great person.
theme: Blocked road — change direction and seek strong allies.
themeEn: The road is hard — turn toward easier ground and seek a great ally.

name: 解
judg: 利西南。无所往，其来复吉。有攸往，夙吉。
judgEn: Thunder releases — tension dissolves. If nothing requires action, return to routine; if it does, act swiftly.
theme: Relief arrives — return to normal or act fast.
themeEn: Tension dissolves — return to routine, or if action is needed, act early.

name: 损
judg: 有孚，元吉，无咎，可贞，利有攸往。曷之用？二簋可用享。
judgEn: Decrease below to increase above — sincere simplification brings great luck; two plain bowls suffice for the offering.
theme: Subtract — less, done sincerely, is more.
themeEn: Deliberate decrease — sincere simplicity brings great good fortune.

name: 益
judgEn: Increase from above — wind and thunder magnify each other; great crossings and ventures are favored.
theme: Growth phase — invest, expand, cross the great river.
themeEn: Increase — wind and thunder magnify each other; invest and venture boldly.

name: 夬
judg: 扬于王庭，孚号有厉。告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。
judgEn: Resolute breakthrough — declare the truth openly; force alone fails, but determined advance succeeds.
theme: Breakthrough moment — be resolute, not reckless.
themeEn: Breakthrough — declare truth openly and advance resolutely, not violently.

name: 姤
judgEn: An unexpected encounter — something small arrives with great force; do not bind yourself to it.
theme: Unexpected element intrudes — don't commit yet.
themeEn: An unexpected force appears — observe it; don't bind yourself to it yet.

name: 萃
judg: 亨。王假有庙，利见大人。亨，利贞。用大牲吉。利有攸往。
judgEn: Gathering — collective assembly around a shared center succeeds; meet the great person, prepare generously.
theme: Convene people around a shared center — go big.
themeEn: Assembly around a shared center — gather generously and meet the great.

name: 升
judg: 元亨，用见大人，勿恤，南征吉。
judgEn: Growth like a tree rising — steady upward effort succeeds; seek the great person's counsel without anxiety.
theme: Steady climb — keep pushing up, seek mentorship.
themeEn: The tree grows upward — steady effort and good counsel raise you higher.

name: 困
judg: 亨，贞，大人吉，无咎。有言不信。
judgEn: Confinement — the great person stays serene and finds the way through; words carry no credit now, so let action speak.
theme: Exhausted — stay serene, act quietly, don't argue.
themeEn: Exhaustion — keep inner greatness serene; words won't be believed, let action speak.

name: 井
judg: 改邑不改井，无丧无得，往来井井。汔至亦未繘井，羸其瓶，凶。
judgEn: The well — a dependable source that nourishes all; draw carefully and finish the work, or the jug breaks.
theme: Be the reliable well — finish what you draw.
themeEn: Be the dependable well — nourish others, and finish the drawing.

name: 革
judg: 巳日乃孚，元亨利贞，悔亡。
judgEn: Molting — when the time is ripe, radical change wins trust; transformation done at the right moment removes regret.
theme: Revolution is ripe — change at the right day.
themeEn: The skin must molt — well-timed radical change wins trust.

name: 鼎
judgEn: The sacred vessel — cultivation of the able and nourishment of the worthy bring supreme good fortune.
theme: Institution-building — nourish the worthy, refine yourself.
themeEn: The cauldron — cultivate the able and nourish the worthy; supreme luck.

name: 震
judg: 亨。震来虩虩，笑言哑哑。震惊百里，不丧匕鬯。
judgEn: Thunder doubles — the shock that makes one tremble also brings the laughter of composure; the steady hand does not drop the ritual spoon.
theme: Shockwave — stay composed and you'll laugh after.
themeEn: Thunder shocks — composure through the scare earns the laughter after.

name: 艮
judg: 艮其背，不获其身；行其庭，不见其人。无咎。
judgEn: Stillness — stopping at the right time, in the right place, in the right way brings no blame.
theme: Be still — stop where you are, in the right way.
themeEn: Mountain stillness — stop at the right time and place; no blame.

name: 渐
judgEn: Gradual advance like the wild goose — orderly development in courtship and ventures brings good fortune.
theme: Progress step by step — no rushing the stages.
themeEn: The goose advances in order — step-by-step development brings good fortune.

name: 归妹
judgEn: Improper union — acting from a lesser position brings misfortune; know your standing or wait.
theme: Wrong footing in a relationship or deal — fix the standing first.
themeEn: An unequal union — know your standing, or advancing brings misfortune.

name: 丰
judgEn: Abundance at noon — be like the sun at midday: clear, generous, decisive. Don't worry; use the peak.
theme: Peak abundance — act decisively at high noon.
themeEn: Abundance at high noon — be clear, generous and decisive at the peak.

name: 旅
judgEn: The traveler — in transient circumstances modesty and correct conduct bring small success and good fortune.
theme: In transit — travel light and mind your manners.
themeEn: The wanderer — in transient times, modest conduct brings small success.

name: 巽
judg: 小亨，利有攸往，利见大人。
judgEn: Wind — gentle persistent influence succeeds in small matters; favorable to advance and meet the great person.
theme: Influence gently and persistently, like wind.
themeEn: Wind-like persistence — gentle influence advances where force fails.

name: 兑
judgEn: Joyous exchange — shared pleasure and sincere speech succeed when grounded in steadiness.
theme: Joy and honest exchange — share, teach, negotiate.
themeEn: The joyous lake — sincere and cheerful exchange succeeds when grounded.

name: 涣
judg: 亨。王假有庙，利涉大川，利贞。
judgEn: Dispersion — dissolving rigidity and selfishness; gather people around a higher shared purpose.
theme: Melt the rigid — rally people to a higher purpose.
themeEn: Dissolve rigidity — rally scattered forces around a higher purpose.

name: 节
judgEn: Measured restraint succeeds — but bitter, excessive restriction cannot endure.
theme: Set limits — but not bitter ones that break you.
themeEn: Right measure succeeds — but bitter over-restriction cannot last.

name: 中孚
judgEn: Inner truth — sincerity so complete it moves even the simplest creatures; great crossings are favored.
theme: Absolute sincerity — it moves even pigs and fish.
themeEn: Inner truth — sincerity that reaches the simplest hearts crosses great rivers.

name: 小过
judg: 亨，利贞。可小事，不可大事。飞鸟遗之音，不宜上，宜下，大吉。
judgEn: Small exceeding — minor deviations succeed now; like the flying bird, stay low and grounded for great fortune.
theme: Small deviations OK — stay low-key, fly below the radar.
themeEn: Minor excesses pass — stay grounded and low-key; great fortune lies below.

name: 既济
judgEn: After completion — everything is in place, but order decays if unwatched: good beginnings demand vigilant endings.
theme: Done — but vigilance now decides how it ends.
themeEn: All in place — yet good beginnings decay without vigilant endings.

name: 未济
judg: 亨。小狐汔济，濡其尾，无攸利。
judgEn: Before completion — the little fox nearly crosses but wets its tail; careless final steps undo the whole crossing.
theme: Almost there — careful final steps, don't wet your tail.
themeEn: Nearly across — the careless final step wets the fox's tail; finish carefully.
